info.title: Tender Intelligence Engine, REST v1 for callers

post.description:
Which tenders satisfy a condition on one field, over approved facts only. Send the
structured query (`field_path`, `operator`, `value`), or a `question` that is read into
one; the answer returns the query that ran.

get.description:
Tenders side by side: fields as rows, tenders as columns, provenance on every cell,
a field not reviewed marked as such. A tender whose publication is suspended is left
out with the reason.

parameters.description: Comma-separated tender ids, at most six
parameters.name: ids

schema.description: Comma-separated tender ids, at most six
schema.title: Ids

post.description:
A new tender from its RfS: a file, or the official URL it is published at (the host
must be on infra/source-domains.yaml). Without `tender_type` the classifier names the
type. The document is parsed, mapped, indexed and read without another call;
`GET /tenders/{id}/status` says where it stands. `priority` reads with direct calls
instead of the batch API. Needs the `write` scope.

Ask one question about a tender. The answer names its source (`approved` fact,
`machine` reading) and cites pages with quotes the evidence resolver located; an
unresolved quote is shown as such. Never a fact.

get.description:
The changelog across versions: per version, the facts it changed (old to new, a
withdrawal flagged) with their evidence, decision date and reviewer role; an
unreviewed version lists the fields it may touch, by path only.

The snapshot (contract v1): every field with value, unit, page, quote, version,
state (value, withdrawn, not_stated), approved or machine, and confidence.

post.description:
Queue the chunks of every document of the tender for retrieval again (after a
re-parse, or for documents parsed before retrieval existed).

schema.title: Response Index Tender Api V1 Tenders  Tender Id  Index Post

get.description:
The published view: canonical facts only, each with the version that set it, its
evidence pages, the review date and the reviewer's role; the publication state with
its banner; a field without a fact as a gap with its reason and the likely page. While
an unreviewed version touches a critical field the view carries the suspension and the
amending documents instead of values.

The published view as a PDF: cover, facts by section with a reference number each,
the changelog, and an appendix of page references.

post.description:
A review link for a named reviewer (one reviewer per tender; an earlier link stops
working). The link is a credential: hand it to the reviewer, store it nowhere else.
Needs the `review:mint` scope.

get.description:
Where the tender's reading stands: per version its documents, runs and pending
jobs; the tender's review and publication state.

schema.title: Response List Webhooks Api V1 Webhooks Get

post.description:
Register a URL for events (extraction_done, review_complete, new_version,
amendment_detected). Every delivery is signed with the secret
(`X-Tender-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>">`) and retried with
backoff. Needs the `write` scope.

delete.description: Stop deliveries to the endpoint; its record and its deliveries stay.

get.description: The latest deliveries to the endpoint, newest first, with each one's outcome.

schema.title: Response List Deliveries Api V1 Webhooks  Endpoint Id  Deliveries Get
